newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan appoints new representative in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan appoints new representative in Singapore.

text.p: Taiwan has appointed a senior career diplomat to head its unofficial representative office in Singapore, local newspapers reported on Sunday.
Ouyang Jui-hsiung, 56, director-general of Taiwan's representative office in Los Angeles, will replace Cheyne Chiu as Taiwan's representative in the city state, the reports said.
Singapore has diplomatic ties with Taiwan's rival, China, but maintains close unofficial relations with the island.
China, which regards Taiwan as a renegade province, has tried to push the island into international isolation since a civil war separated them in 1949.
